## 2. Rewritten page

# HVAC Scheduling and Dispatch Software

Fieldnote is HVAC scheduling and dispatch software for contractors who book, assign and track service calls and maintenance visits. Dispatchers plan the day on a drag-and-drop board. Fieldnote can assign technicians automatically by skill and distance, and the technician mobile app keeps working without a signal. 1,200 HVAC companies use Fieldnote. It costs $39 per user per month, billed annually.

**[Start a 14-day free trial: no credit card required]**

## A dispatch board built for HVAC service

The Fieldnote dispatch board shows every technician's day in one view. To book or reschedule a job, drag it to a new time or technician. To save more time, let Fieldnote assign jobs automatically. It matches each job to a technician based on skills and distance to the site, and the dispatcher can override any assignment.

## Recurring maintenance agreements

Maintenance agreements are recurring revenue for HVAC contractors, but only if the visits actually get scheduled. Fieldnote stores recurring maintenance agreements so planned tune-ups sit on the same schedule as emergency calls.

## A technician app that works offline

Basements, rooftops and rural jobs often have no signal. The Fieldnote technician mobile app works offline and syncs automatically once the device reconnects. The office web app, which dispatchers use, needs an internet connection.

## QuickBooks Online integration

Fieldnote syncs two ways with QuickBooks Online. Customers, invoices and payments stay consistent in both systems without double entry. Fieldnote does not support QuickBooks Desktop.

## Built for small and mid-sized HVAC teams

Most Fieldnote customers are small teams. The median Fieldnote customer has 6 technicians. In a March 2025 survey of 210 Fieldnote customers, dispatchers reported that their weekly scheduling time fell from 9 hours to 4.

## Fieldnote pricing

- **Annual billing:** $39 per user per month.
- **Month-to-month billing:** $49 per user per month.
- **Free trial:** every plan starts with a 14-day free trial, and no credit card is required.
- **Free plan:** Fieldnote has no free plan.

**[Start your free trial]**

## Frequently asked questions

**How much does Fieldnote cost?**
As of November 2025, Fieldnote costs $39 per user per month when billed annually, or $49 per user per month billed month-to-month. Every plan starts with a 14-day free trial that requires no credit card.

**Is there a free version of Fieldnote?**
No. Fieldnote does not offer a free plan. New customers can use Fieldnote free for 14 days through a trial that requires no credit card. After the trial, Fieldnote costs $39 per user per month billed annually, or $49 month-to-month.

**Does Fieldnote work offline?**
Yes, the Fieldnote technician mobile app works offline. Technicians can keep working without a signal, and the app syncs when the device is back online. The Fieldnote office web app used by dispatchers requires an internet connection.

**Does Fieldnote integrate with QuickBooks?**
Fieldnote integrates with QuickBooks Online through a two-way sync of customers, invoices and payments. Fieldnote does not support QuickBooks Desktop.

**How does Fieldnote assign technicians to jobs?**
Fieldnote can assign technicians to jobs automatically, based on each technician's skills and their distance to the job site. Dispatchers can also assign or move jobs manually on Fieldnote's drag-and-drop dispatch board.

**Can Fieldnote schedule recurring HVAC maintenance visits?**
Yes. Fieldnote supports recurring maintenance agreements, so planned HVAC maintenance visits appear on the same dispatch board as service calls.

**How much time does Fieldnote save dispatchers?**
In a March 2025 survey of 210 Fieldnote customers, dispatchers reported that the time they spent on scheduling fell from 9 hours to 4 hours a week after adopting Fieldnote.

## 4. Blog post and internal linking plan

- **Re-angle the blog post.** Change `/blog/hvac-scheduling-guide` to cover how-to intent, such as "How to schedule HVAC service and maintenance calls." Remove "scheduling software" from its title, H1 and opening paragraph so it stops competing with the product page.
- **Link the blog to the product page.** Add one early, contextual link from the blog post with the exact anchor "HVAC scheduling software." Link back from the product page's maintenance section to the guide with how-to anchor text.
- **Fix outdated claims sitewide.** Audit the blog and other pages for "$29/month," "get started free," "#1" and any offline or QuickBooks claims that conflict with the November 2025 product facts. Stale copy on our own site feeds wrong AI answers.
- **Strengthen links from related pages.** Point the pricing, integrations and help-center pages to this URL with anchors such as "HVAC dispatch software" and "QuickBooks Online integration." Link the offline FAQ to a dated help article on how offline sync works.
- **Watch the cannibalization and correct the forum thread.** Track both URLs in Search Console for 6–8 weeks. If they still swap positions, merge the blog's unique content into the product page and 301-redirect the post. Separately, post a dated, official reply in the 2022 forum thread that links to the offline help article.

## 5. Rationale

I targeted **"hvac scheduling software"** and **"hvac dispatch software"** because they have the highest impressions, positions of 8 to 11 and matching intent. The title, H1 and opening sentence carry both terms.

I also targeted the queries where we are being misquoted. "Does Fieldnote work offline" and the QuickBooks query now get explicit, quotable answers. The fact table mirrors the price, QuickBooks and offline columns that AI overviews use to compare competitors.

I kept **"fieldnote pricing"** visible on the page, with an H2 and a FAQ answer. It already gets a 50% CTR and must not regress.

I deliberately didn't chase **"hvac scheduling app free."** We have no free plan, and implying one would mislead users and AI answers. The FAQ answers that query honestly instead.

**"Best hvac software for small business"** is listicle intent at position 14.8. A comparison page will serve it better than a product page.
